w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: You catch Raniera telling the fire about Ethan. "Ethan came back mauled by The Redactor (3 rounds, 22 taken) and alive. Three white lines across the forearm now." The story's already growing.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🍂 Ethan gathers deadfall — 3 sticks. The pile grows. (145 sticks now.)
🧳 Stonebridge has split — the hardliners walked. They call the new fire The Bloodied. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (24/11/7), with 5 wave-4 fought, 9 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 7 · Forage 18 · Craft 8 · Talk 15 · Explore 43 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Devon Okafor ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
